text: Lol. thats awesome xD not. hey so uh i keep falling thru the world when trying to just load it :? it honestly looks like im spawning like just below it in height and then falling because im below the ground. maybe raise my spawn drop or something
resolution: Diagnosed from the user's own saved data: sessions/_route-twigs.json holds the /test player pose at y=0 (x 3.4, z 3.75, saved ~8h earlier, grounded) — from BEFORE the terrain there was painted up. PlayRoute's pose restore only snapped to the live floor when the saved y was more than a full capsule height (~1.8m) below groundColumnTop, so a ~1m burial kept the stale y and restored the player INSIDE the painted heightfield — below its top, where no collider can catch a body — and they fell through the world on every load (the pose kept re-saving, so it never self-healed). Fix 865cfe050 (PlayRoute.tsx): terrain is the world's minimum — nothing legitimate stands under groundColumnTop — so the burial slack shrinks from capsuleHeight to 0.05m float noise; ANY below-ground restore now lands ON the live floor, grounded, and the existing '[play] restored player pose was below the live floor; snapping to ground' warn names it when it fires. Saves go live via the hot-reload watcher; the user should just press Play again and spawn standing on the painted ground.
